0022600113.text: The Indiana Pacers (1-1, 9th in the East) are on the road against the Brooklyn Nets (0-1, 10th in the East) in the Pacers' third game of the 2026-27 season, with Indiana 1-0 away and Brooklyn 0-1 at home. The teams have not met yet this season, but the Pacers won the 2025-26 series 2-1, including a 123-94 win in Brooklyn on April 9, 2026. Indiana is missing Ben Sheppard (knee), Johnny Furphy (knee, surgery), and T.J. McConnell (hamstring), and Aaron Nesmith is day-to-day with a hamstring strain and a game-time decision, while Brooklyn is without Tyler Bilodeau (shoulder).
